title: The **Prime-Embedded Quantum Multiplicity Counting Algorithm (PEQMCA)** introduces **prime-number encoding** into the process of **counting quantum multiplicities** in quantum systems. **Multiplicity counting** in quantum mechanics involves determining the number of degenerate eigenstates corresponding to the same eigenvalue, which is crucial for understanding the structure of quantum systems, including **quantum degeneracies**, **entanglement**, and **state transitions**. By embedding primes into this counting process, we introduce **dynamic modulation** over how the multiplicities are calculated, enhancing control over **quantum state interactions**, **quantum measurements**, and **quantum transitions**.
